span.term: Glutamatergic alvear terminals in stratum oriens excite local interneurons, which in turn hyperpolarize CA1 pyramidal cells through GABA-A receptors, so the net effect of the pathway on pyramidal cells is inhibition rather than excitation
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms

span.label: the excitatory input onto pyramidal cells is monosynaptic but too weak to reach threshold even under theta burst stimulation

span.note: RETRACTED: THE LITERATURE'S DISPUTE, TAGGED AS THIS PAPER'S OPERATIONALISATION. The edge is `EPSP --operationalised-as--> excitation`. The span opens: 'Quotation withheld of CA1 PCs' followed by FIVE citations spanning 1966 to 1995. The sentence reports that the field does not agree, and the edge records the disputed relation as though it were settled and measured here. THE WORST FORM OF THIS CLASS: an edge that asserts exactly what its own sentence says is contested. WHAT THE SPAN DOES SAY (Q-309): that the in vivo result is disputed across five papers and that the ex vivo route is the one this paper goes on to use.
